method: Seeded from the live page inventory (31 marketing routes, 76 journal API records) crawled on 2026-10-31 between 18:15 and 18:35 (+08). One primary keyword per URL, at most three secondaries. Demand tiers are business-proximity ranks, not volumes: no keyword-volume provider, no Search Console and no GA4 are connected to this site, so every volume and traffic number is unverified and none is stated.

measurement.firstPartyEvents: write-only endpoints (/api/site-events, /api/blog/events) - no read surface, no dashboard
measurement.consequence: No traffic, ranking, impression, click or lead figure for this site can be sourced today. Analysis below is structural (crawl, inventory, link graph, on-page completeness).

rules: One primary keyword per URL. A new article may not take the primary of an existing money page.
Every new article names the URL it will not cannibalise and the three pages it links to, before drafting.
House standard: answer-first opening, 1,800-2,400 words, one H1, IDR table, 4-6 FAQs, scope disclaimer, /pricing + /get-started + WhatsApp.
Tax, legal and immigration statements stay descriptive and point to a licensed adviser. No conclusions.
Re-audit this map after every ten published articles.
